messages:
Maya Chen: DataCorp wants an on-prem/VPC POC next week. They're asking us to waive the one-time platform fee and bump support to Gold for the trial. Can Deal Desk grant a fee waiver + discount? @Jordi can you confirm ops/SE requirements?

Jordi Alvarez: We can do Gold for the POC but it needs 16h SE (env, SSO, KMS review) and dedicated node reservations to meet latency targets. Ops needs 48h notice. Prep ETA = 3 business days.

Priya Singh: Financials: platform fee = $50k, annual license = $120k. A 30% year1 discount = $36k. Waiving fee + 30% ~= $86k impact year1. Too large for a simple POC.

Priya Singh: Counter: waive the one-time fee for the POC, offer 20% off year1, and include a conversion clause: if Customer signs a >=$150k 12-month paid license within 90 days of POC end, the waived fee converts to a credit on year1 invoice. Otherwise the waived fee is non-refundable.

Maya Chen: I'll propose 20% + conversion clause to the customer.

Owen Patel: Legal ok with the conversion language. Suggest exact contract line: "If Customer executes a 12-month paid platform license >= $150,000 within 90 days of POC completion, Redwood will apply a credit equal to the waived one-time platform fee to Customer's first invoice. If not, the waived fee will be treated as non-refundable consideration for POC services."

Jordi Alvarez: Note for SOW: add SE 16h, ops reservation owner, KMS checklist, and "Dedicated reservation for POC week - ops to be notified 2 business days prior".

Maya Chen: I'll update the SOW and request customer countersign.

deal-desk-bot: Deal Desk Request DD-2026-142 submitted by @Maya Chen - waive platform fee for POC, 20% first-year discount, credit-on-commit >= $150k within 90 days clause, SE hours + dedicated nodes in SOW. Action: APPROVE / DENY / COUNTER.

Priya Singh: Approve pending SOW shows SE hours and ops cost center. Discount capped at 20% and credit conversion conditions as stated.

Owen Patel: Legal approves.

deal-desk-bot: DD-2026-142 status: APPROVED (Priya Singh, Owen Patel). Terms recorded.

Maya Chen: Thanks team - pushing SOW to signature now.
